items.title: AAT Architecten about
items.description: A short studio credo: a small portrait photo at the left, then one large paragraph whose first line starts where the photo ends, and an underlined 'more about us' link. The paragraph's lines rise out of masks one after another when it comes into view; the photo and the link fade in with the scroll.
notes: needs JavaScript (hydrate: idle) for the line reveal; without it the paragraph simply shows
the scroll fade of the photo and link needs CSS scroll-driven animations; elsewhere they simply show
the photo slot is a muted placeholder until you pass media

items.description: An architect's monochrome: white paper, near-black ink and one mid grey for secondary numbers and the quiet half of headlines. Inter throughout, uppercase semibold headlines set solid with tight tracking; square corners, 1px grey hairlines, no shadows, a 4-column desktop grid with 20px gutters.

items.title: Wild AG contact
items.description: A contact section on paper: at the left a light card with three pill-shaped fields outlined in soft taupe (name, email, a tall rounded message box) and a gradient pill submit; at the right, vertically centred, a gradient serif-italic title, a one-line invitation, the firm's name and address and a two-column list of phone and email in taupe. items.title: Wild AG header
items.description: A bare header over full-bleed footage: a thin, widely tracked paper wordmark at the left and a two-bar burger at the right (its lower bar halves on hover). Past the first screen a compact pair drops in at the top right: a gradient 'Contact' pill and a round paper burger disc. The burger opens a full-window paper menu of large uppercase links that turn to the brand gradient on hover.
notes: it overlays the top of the page (absolute) with paper-coloured marks: the first section should be dark footage or a gradient band
the compact pair appears after the page scrolls past `threshold` (a fraction of the window height)
desktop layout inferred: on the original the intro curtain hid the header in every desktop frame

items.title: Wild AG reveal
items.description: A wrapper that fades its content up into place as it scrolls into view: opacity 0 to 1 and a 40px rise, driven by the scroll itself (CSS view timeline). Give items in a column a step number to stagger them.
notes: CSS only: browsers without scroll-driven animations, and reduced motion, show the content in place
the range is a fixed 240px of scroll after the element's top enters, so things in the first screen are already in place
don't put it inside an overflow-hidden box (use overflow-clip), or the timeline freezes

items.title: Wild AG
items.description: Warm paper-white and a pinker light surface, espresso ink and warm-grey text, with a taupe-to-sand brand gradient for bands, card panels and titles. Inter for running text and labels, Inria Serif italic for uppercase section titles; 16px corners, pills everywhere else, flat.
notes: light is the faithful mode; dark is a sibling in deep espresso with the same taupe and sand
primary is the taupe (gradient start), highlight the sand (gradient end): blocks paint the brand gradient as from-primary to-highlight
muted/card is the pinker light surface of whole bands and raised tiles; secondary is the sand used for media placeholders
border is the taupe at 25%, the colour of every hairline and pill outline
radius 16px; the bands' big bottom radius is computed from it (x3.4 on phones, x4.5 from 1024px)
gutter 18px on phones, 48px from 768px, 80px from 1024px; --page-width is the 1160px content column inside the gutters
items.name: wild-ag-theme

items.title: Wild AG ticker
items.description: An endless horizontal ticker: its content is laid twice side by side and the pair slides left by one copy, linear and forever, so the line never ends. Used for a giant type line and for a row of partner tiles.
notes: CSS only; reduced motion stops it in place
the content should be at least as wide as the window, or repeat it inside before passing it
